title: Singapore with the Genting Dream Cruise
alt: Cruise ship berthed at the Marina Bay Cruise Centre in Singapore
transport: Private airport and port transfers with shared coaches for tours

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Three nights on land then two at sea works beautifully. You see the whole city, then stop deciding anything for two days.
expert.tip: Book a balcony cabin if the budget stretches. The sail out past the anchored tankers at dusk is worth sitting outside for.

summary: Six days split between the city and the sea. The Night Safari, a city tour with the Sentosa cable car and a full day at Universal Studios, then two nights aboard the Genting Dream with all meals included.
included: Included: 3 nights at the ibis Novena with breakfast; 2 nights aboard the Genting Dream with breakfast, lunch and dinner; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; two way cable car sky pass; Universal Studios one day pass; 8 private and shared transfers including the cruise terminal.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; port charges and gratuities; speciality restaurants and paid decks on board; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: City tour and the Sentosa cable car

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the ibis Novena
Check in and take a few hours to settle
Shared transfer to Mandai for the Night Safari with a tram ride
Back in town for a late supper near Novena MRT
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, Chinatown and the civic district
Two way cable car sky pass from Mount Faber across to Sentosa
Evening free on the island or back at VivoCity
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Afternoon shows and the themed streets at your own pace
4: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer to the Marina Bay Cruise Centre
Board the Genting Dream and find your cabin
Lunch on board, then the pool deck and the waterslides
Optional: the zipline, the rope course and the Zouk beach club on deck
5: A full day at sea with all meals on board
Optional: the spa, the waterslide park and the Zodiac theatre shows
Rock climbing wall and the sports deck through the afternoon
Dinner and a show before the last night on board
6: Breakfast on board and disembark at the Marina Bay Cruise Centre
Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 3★ · ibis Novena, two minutes from Novena MRT station

program.name: Three city nights
program.description: Novena as a base for the Night Safari, a city tour with the Sentosa cable car and a full theme park day.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the Mandai park after dark, past the elephants, hyenas and the big cats.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour of Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the civic district.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride from Mount Faber over HarbourFront to Sentosa, with the container port below.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass covering Sci Fi City, Ancient Egypt, Far Far Away and the Hollywood boulevard shows.

stops.name: Genting Dream
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast, lunch and dinner included · Standard cabin · Genting Dream, sailing from the Marina Bay Cruise Centre

program.name: Two nights at sea
program.description: A short sailing on the Genting Dream with all meals on board, a waterslide park, a zipline over the deck and evening shows.

activities.name: Waterslide Park on Deck
activities.description: Six slides and a splash pool on the upper decks of the Genting Dream, open through the day at sea.

activities.name: Zipline and Rope Course
activities.description: A zipline and a ropes circuit strung above the deck, with the sea on both sides of you.

activities.name: Zouk Beach Club
activities.description: The ship's pool and club deck, quiet in the afternoon and busy once the sun goes down.

activities.name: Crystal Life Spa
activities.description: The spa deck with saunas, a thalassotherapy pool and treatment rooms, booked on board.
